messages:
Ava (AE): Quick sync — SoftWave is asking for a 2‑week POC: semantic search over docs + a chat assistant. They gave an expected volume: ~200k queries/day. Need rough capacity + budget for presales deck by EOD.
Ken (Solutions): Quick clarifying Q: is that 200k embed lookups, 200k chat requests, or combined?
Ava (AE): Combined. They expect ~150k embed lookups (for recall) + 50k chat turns. Peak traffic windows are important — they called out 10x spikes for short bursts during sync jobs.
Priya (ML Eng): Ok. For sizing we need avg tokens per chat turn (prompt + context + response). Do we have a prompt template?
Ava (AE): They shared a sample: average prompt ~350 tokens, expected reply ~400 tokens, plus retrieving top-5 docs (each ~250 tokens) for context in generation path.
Priya (ML Eng): Rough calc per chat turn = 350 + 400 + (5 * 250) = ~2,000 tokens. If 50k chat turns/day => 100M tokens/day for generation path. Embeds: 150k docs/day for lookup -> embedding creation only on ingestion; lookups are vector ops (charged differently).
Lukas (Infra): Translating to QPS: 200k/day ≈ 2.3 rps average, but with 10x bursts => ~23 rps. For inference with 2k tokens/turn and target p95 <= 1.5s, recommend either 2 x A100s (for safety) or 4 x A10Gs with batching. For a 2‑week POC we can run a small dedicated pool + autoscale.
Ken (Solutions): Can you give a sketch of cost for the POC (2 weeks) under hosted vs dedicated? Customer wants a ballpark for procurement.
Priya (ML Eng): Hosted (pay-as-you-go) estimate: generation 100M tokens/day * 14 days = 1.4B tokens. If we price at $0.02 / 1K tokens (example hosted rate) => ~$28k for generation. Embeddings: assume 150k docs ingested at $0.0004 / embed => 150k * 0.0004 = $60/day for ingestion * 14 = $840. Total hosted-ish ~ $29k + infra margin. Dedicated (reserved short term): two A100 equivalents for 2 weeks + bandwidth/ops ~ approx $18k-$25k depending on spot vs on-demand. These are roughs — include 25% safety margin.
Ken (Solutions): Good. For the presales slide we should present a conservative estimate: Hosted ~ $35k, Dedicated ~ $25k. Add note: customer could cut costs by truncating context or lowering top-k.
Ava (AE): They asked about latency tail — can we meet 1.5s p95 if we add caching for repeated prefixes and use quantized model?
Priya (ML Eng): Yes. Two levers: (1) KV/prefix caching for repeated user prompts and (2) use an int8 quantized variant with small quality checks. For chat-heavy flows caching alone can reduce token generation by 20-40% depending on repetition.
Lukas (Infra): Suggested runtime config for POC (quick snippet):

```
{"pool": "dedicated-poc",
 "min_replicas": 1,
 "max_replicas": 4,
 "gpu_type": "A10G",
 "batching": {"max_tokens": 2048, "timeout_ms": 10},
 "cache": {"enabled": true, "kv_size": "10GB"}}
```

Lukas (Infra): That config handles bursts and keeps p95 low with batching < 10ms latency overhead.
Mina (Security): FYI customer sent an initial vendor questionnaire and an SOC excerpt. I uploaded the questionnaire to the shared drive and flagged 3 items: data residency, KMS support, and audit log retention. Need timelines for Private option if they require VPC.
Ava (AE): Can we answer the security Qs in time for the POC kickoff next Monday?
Mina (Security): Yes, we can provide canned answers for hosted and note Private deployment lead time (~4 weeks). I'll draft the answers and pass to legal for DPA tweaks.
Ken (Solutions): Success criteria we should align on for the POC slide: (1) end-to-end 1.5s p95 for 80% of traffic, (2) recall@5 >= 0.75 on their eval set, (3) ingest throughput >= 10k docs/hour, (4) cost not exceeding the agreed POC budget ($35k hosted / $25k dedicated). Anyone object?
Priya (ML Eng): Fine. Add a quality regression guard: automated eval on a held-out prompt set run nightly; fail => rollback to previous model.
Ava (AE): Great — I'll put this on the presales deck. Ken, can you confirm the slide copy? Also link to questionnaire: https://drive.company/softwave/presales/questionnaire
Ken (Solutions): Will update slide and ping legal + Mina. Quick ask: can Eng produce a short runbook for the POC operator (deploy steps, scaling knobs, observability queries) by tomorrow morning?
Lukas (Infra): Yes — I'll stub a runbook and share a gist here. EngBot: can you create a POC ticket and calendar invite for kickoff Monday 10am?
EngBot: Created ticket #POC-3892 and calendar invite sent to attendees.
Ava (AE): Thanks all. I'll roll this into the client email and propose the budget ranges. If anything changes, update this thread.
Ken (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Mina (Security): Added questionnaire draft to the ticket.
Priya (ML Eng): I'll attach a short eval script and expected metrics to the ticket by EOD.
